blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines lacks sufficient local evidence to determine how much vaccination can help reduce antibiotic use and antimicrobial resistance (AMR), prompting an Ateneo-led research network to investigate the link between immunization, pneumonia cases and doctors’ prescribing practices.
